nodes.label: Clavium Real-Estate Platform
nodes.rationale: Romanian real-estate platform for direct owner-tenant transactions without intermediaries: discovery, offers, QES-signed contracts and rent payments in one place.

nodes.label: Rental Lifecycle Flow
nodes.rationale: Property listed -> offer sent -> offer accepted -> contract drafted -> signed by both parties (QES) -> contract active -> rent payments tracked.

nodes.label: Four-Step Registration Wizard
nodes.rationale: Registration is refused server-side if the phone was not OTP-verified; public registration can only create CLIENT or OWNER accounts (ADMIN rejected server-side).

nodes.label: JWT HTTP-only Cookie Auth
nodes.rationale: JWT (jose, HS256, 2h) in an HTTP-only sameSite=lax cookie; dashboard access verifies both the JWT and the user in the database, so a forged cookie is rejected.

nodes.label: Route Protection via proxy.ts
nodes.rationale: Anonymous visitors to /dashboard/* are redirected to login and logged-in users are redirected away from /auth/*; implemented in src/proxy.ts (migrated from the middleware.ts convention, deprecated in Next 16).

hyperedges.label: Rental Transaction Lifecycle (list, offer, sign, pay, close)
